name: Pergolide

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and Canada, first in 2007 — for heart harm

summary: Pergolide was removed from the market in the United States and Canada, beginning in 2007, because it caused damage to the heart [3]. In addition, a small computer model calculated risk scores rather than testing actual people, assigning the drug a low risk score of 38 for the liver and a medium risk score of 59 for the heart [M].
